chunks: Al-Sadiq, peace be upon him, said:

key_terms.الصَّادِقُ: Imam Jaʿfar al-Sadiq عليه السلام, the speaker in this report
key_terms.قُصَّهَا: Trim it or cut it short

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام say about trimming it when it becomes long?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام instructs that it should be trimmed when it becomes long. The report reflects guidance related to cleanliness, grooming, and proper etiquette.
